name: Solitaire: Classic Card Games
storyline:
To solve this Solitaire card puzzle, you should move all cards of 4 suits - hearts, diamonds, spades and crosses to the Foundations. There is one deck - 52 cards in the classic Solitaire game.

You need to stack cards by suit, from Aces to King (A, 2, 3 and more). You can also move cards between columns, and stack cards in descending order and differentiate between red and black suits. For example, a black 10 could only be followed by a red 9. Only a King could be placed in the Free Column. You can move the stack of cards by dragging the whole stack to another column.
summary: Enjoy the classic Solitaire card game at any time and place! It's time to relax, relieve stress, train your brain, challenge yourself and be a Patience master.
